issues.where: Encoded crops C and I, in the dark haze just outside the solar loops
issues.what: The smooth falloff breaks into faint rectangular patches at native size, and a few isolated dim stars no longer resolve. The patches are not prominent in the full-frame comparison.
issues.fix: Reduce fine background noise before encoding, then lift the faintest stars slightly so they survive without having to brighten the whole sky.

issues.where: Encoded crops D and E, across the foreground solar cells
issues.what: Some narrow dark seams soften into neighboring highlights. The larger cells and sunspot filaments remain distinct.
issues.fix: Increase local contrast at the cell boundaries without sharpening the finest grain.

issues.where: crop I, Earth night side over the Atlantic storm
issues.what: the faint city-light speckle and the fine cloud streaks are a little dimmer and softer in the encode, so the dark ocean reads slightly flatter than the source
issues.fix: give dark, low-contrast areas a few more bits (for example raise aq-strength or lower the CRF a little for dark scenes)

issues.where: crop D, the cloud-hazed volcano flank near the left limb
issues.what: fine dust and haze texture is slightly smoothed; the volcano rims and ridges still hold, so this is within the expected grain loss
issues.fix: none needed; if wanted, add a light psy-rd or film-grain tune to keep the haze texture

issues.where: crops D and H, star fields beside the limb
issues.what: a few of the faintest single-pixel stars fade a little; no stars that matter vanish, and the limb glow shows no banding or blocking

issues.where: crops H (0,318,225,212) and I (0,530,225,212), encoded right panel
issues.what: the cyan limb glow and lower-right nebula haze break into 8x8/16x16 blocks and stepped bands, over 20% of faint and mid-brightness stars vanish or smear into blobs, and the leftmost ~25px smears into flat horizontal streaks that erase stars along the frame edge
issues.fix: apply stronger 2px spatio-temporal blue-noise dithering across the atmosphere and nebula falloff, tune the stress encoder for dark gradients and point sources (e.g. aq-mode=3 or -tune grain), and fix the x=0 edge-clamp artifact in the video render path

issues.what: dense Milky Way star clouds and warm dust haze degrade across inter-frames into blocky, mushy 8x8 patches, with hundreds of pinpoint stars losing over half their contrast or vanishing into blurred clumps
issues.fix: tighten P/B-frame quantizer ratios (ipratio/pbratio) or enable psy-rd/grain retention in the stress encode, and give sub-pixel stars a slightly wider 1.5-2px soft kernel so inter-frame DCT quantization does not wipe them out

issues.what: inter-frame compression softens the Milky Way dust lanes into blocky clumps and causes dozens of faint cluster stars to vanish compared with the keyframe in image-20.png
issues.fix: reduce P/B-frame quantization drop-off relative to keyframes and preserve high-frequency star contrast with higher psy-rd or slightly larger star point-spread radii

issues.where: full Mars disc, pre-encode left panel vs encoded right panel
issues.what: the pre-encode reference still has radial motion blur across Mars's canyons and craters while the stress-encoded frame is unblurred on the disc and clamped along the left border, preventing an exact like-for-like frame comparison (also visible in image-18.png crops C, D, and G)
issues.fix: save the pre-encode reference PNGs directly from the exact frame buffer fed to ffmpeg during npm run stress so both sides share identical camera velocity and shader state

issues.where: crops C (1328,164,225,212) and E (1328,704,225,212), encoded right panel
issues.what: in Mars's dark terminator and nightside shadow falloff, compression strips out the fine grain and leaves subtle blotchy macroblocking and luma/chroma stepping
issues.fix: use dark-biased adaptive quantization (aq-mode=3) and slightly coarser 2x2-correlated blue-noise dithering in near-black shadow regions so gradients survive yuv420p quantization

issues.where: crops D (368,704,225,212) and E (1328,704,225,212), encoded right panel
issues.what: quantization flattens the dithered dark sky gradient into stepped 8x8 macroblocks around the blue planet's nightside and outer cyan glow edge while dimming faint isolated stars (persisting across image-19.png through image-24.png)
issues.fix: allocate more bits to dark blocks via aq-mode=3 and add low-frequency dither above the yuv420p quantization threshold along the outer limb falloff and deep-space background
